as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin refuses James Fox interview

plain: A UFO documentary filmmaker, James Fox, says that in the late 1990s he chased Buzz Aldrin, the Apollo 11 astronaut who walked on the moon, all the way to Monte Carlo for an interview about UFOs, only for Aldrin to call it off at the last minute with the words "I'm not doing the interview." A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells the story with some changes: he places it in the 2000s, says Fox finally cornered Aldrin, links it to the billionaire Paul Allen, and quotes Aldrin asking "What would my testimony do anyways?" For those who tell it, the point is that a moonwalker may have something to say about UFOs and chose not to say it.
